text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Trainer, look, look!! It's fan mail 
for Turbo!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo showed me the fan letters she 
received. However—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With colorful paints and exceptionally 
wild brushstrokes, something resembling a 
painting has been drawn...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I'm sooo happy~~! I can't believe you're 
drawing a picture of Turbo running!
choice_data_list: Wait, is that a drawing of Turbo...?
Wait, is that a drawing of Turbo...!?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Wait, yeah! Because that's how it is, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Look, look closely! That squiggly blue 
line is Turbo's hair, right?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
So, the whizzing yellow circle is foot 
speed, and the swirling red line is the 
momentum of the air!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As expected of a Twin Turbo fan, perhaps— 
they seem to share a very similar 
sensibility with her.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, Turbo's fans are so amazing~~♪

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo wants to see waaaay more Turbo 
drawings! I want you to draw them!! 
Turbo's gonna do her bestーー!!
